column1: # See android.tsv for the measured bring-up status.
# Startup requests a 0xC9400000-byte heap; the reservation leaves 3328 MB for it.
# The NPDM declares no system resource; virtual address memory is disabled.
# 60 fps through the frame step stub of patches.py (the frame delta from real time); DM_FPS_TARGET=0 leaves the game's own 30 fps
# the game steps by the frame's real time at any pace: frames are shown as soon as they are ready, not held for whole vsyncs (held, the first late frames after a load
# kept the battle at 30 fps on the Odin 3 though its frames took 11 ms)
